title: Implement agentd lifecycle skeleton
purpose: Create the minimal agentd process model needed for PID 1 operation, health reporting, shutdown handling, and deterministic module boundaries.
scope: Define agentd module boundaries for planner, policy, capability, tool router, audit, rollback, model broker, and TUI.
Implement process signal handling suitable for PID 1 responsibilities.
Expose health/status endpoint over Unix domain socket or local control interface.
Stub each internal API from Plan through Recover without executing real side effects.
acceptance_criteria: agentd starts as the boot handoff target and stays alive.
agentd can report status, module readiness, and last error.
agentd handles termination and child reaping paths deliberately.
All stub APIs return typed results and structured errors.
verification: Run unit tests for lifecycle and API stubs.
Run image boot smoke test with agentd skeleton.
Force a controlled agentd error and verify health output.
risk_notes: Avoid making PID 1 a large business-logic process; adapters should remain separate child services where possible.
